allowedProviders.label: Google 翻譯
allowedProviders.note: Keep the AutoBuild-style Google provider. Normalize every result with OpenCC S2TWP before display.

allowedProviders.label: Bing 翻譯
allowedProviders.note: Keep the AutoBuild-style Bing provider. Normalize every result with OpenCC S2TWP before display.

outputRules.forChineseOrCantoneseAsr: Convert recognized Chinese text with S2TWP; do not call a translation provider just to convert script/terms.
outputRules.failureBehavior: Show an explicit translation failure state. In source-plus-translation mode the original source caption may remain; never label source text as a successful Chinese translation.

tests: Provider UI lists Google and Bing only.
Youdao has no reachable dispatch path.
Tencent has no reachable dispatch path.
All successful provider responses pass through OpenCC S2TWP before display.
Provider failures never fall back to Simplified Chinese.
Chinese and Cantonese recognition use OpenCC S2TWP without Youdao/Tencent.
